Inventory Unit Cost

Set specific unit costs for inventory items on particular dates.

Unit costs affect inventory valuations and cost of goods sold calculations.

Date

Select the date from which this unit cost should apply. The system will use this cost for calculations from this date forward until a newer cost is entered.

Inventory Item

Select the inventory item for which you want to set or adjust the unit cost.

Unit cost

Enter the unit cost for this inventory item. This cost will be used for inventory valuation and cost of goods sold calculations.
